This is a gap description, not a fourth-material or experiment authorization.

nominal_bytes_only.actual_byte_freeze_requires: returned format, stride/sizeimage, each buffer plane length/data_offset/bytesused and actual DMA descriptors/segments

如选择完整应用目标，则每个需保存帧的完整write/close及文件内容校验、最终持久化是否要求也须冻结。现源码保存错误不是完整成功证明。

foreground.completion_boundary: DMA buffer ready != CPU consumption complete != buffer requeued != full frame file/application complete. DQBUF is userspace-visible completion, not a per-AXI transaction trace.

identity.source_limit: No separate application/source/program fetched beyond the approved three; existing capture-output files are not independent BG.

optional_added_workload.value: Upload or download one already existing, capture-independent finite file over actual GEM. Explicitly added concurrency, not source-native demo behaviour.

arrival.freeze_requirement: Identify actual request/availability event and ready bytes before scheduling; never derive release from desired IOMMU interference.

bytes_and_work.freeze_requirement: Exact existing file length/hash, direction, protocol, descriptor segmentation, source/destination availability, software supply and complete device traffic.

natural_end.proposed_completion_definition: Complete all frozen bytes and protocol/device completion; retain tail until naturally quiet. Do not stop BG when capture ends.

completion_target.value: Full finite-transfer progress/completion may be a valid goal without deadline; no actual application deadline invented.

background.independence: No dependence on frames captured in this foreground. Foreground -F file writes remain foreground consumption; do not count them as independent BG.

shared_iommu_path.default_source_configuration: PC3 default MMU-500 disabled; GEM iommus commented. The SDI PL capture master/StreamID is not identified in this base DTS.
shared_iommu_path.generic_USB_check: PC3 USB mappings commented too. This is an anti-shortcut observation, not a second candidate or evidence all USB/camera paths bypass.
needed: capture PL master connection and stream ID
shared IOTLB/TCU identity, not just controller marketing name

mapping_and_preparation.native_permissions: YAVTA MMAP/USERPTR choices do not prove IOVA mapping authority, physical contiguity, page size, pinned lifetime or user right to premake IOTLB entries.
allowed_strong_baseline_if_legal: allocate/pin stable ring before STREAMON; map every known buffer before QBUF
use legal huge pages when allocation, alignment, device addressing, driver/domain and lifetime permit
perform legal translation/data preparation before release; count allocation, map/sync/invalidation/prewarm and retained-memory cost
partition or bound outstanding transfer service only with existing platform controls and complete cost

legal_control_timing.native_capture: User controls allocations, format/stream setup and QBUF ownership before queued work. Requeue after DQBUF consumption can be delayed; effect on incoming frames/backpressure/overrun must be costed. No source proves revocable running transfer or instantaneous intra-frame priority.
legal_control_timing.current_platform_boundary_from_root: NEXT/DONE register control before job publication; STOP only drains current job and cannot cancel an already published copy.
legal_control_timing.mapping_to_iDMA: A SDI stream-to-DDR capture cannot be silently replaced by a whole-frame DDR-to-DDR copy released at a chosen period. Producer readiness/stream bridge/backpressure must be explicit.

strong_ordinary_strategy_and_hypothesis.baseline: Static known ring prepared/mapped legally before capture, legally large pages if available; prioritize capture at existing pre-publication control; admit only bounded background pieces in genuine slack with outstanding limits and continue full BG to natural completion. Include feedback scheduling at legal completion/ownership boundaries.
strong_ordinary_strategy_and_hypothesis.failure_hypothesis: If a measured producer period and jitter leave a finite slot-reuse margin, page size/translation residence and service cannot be guaranteed by those legal preparations, and a background piece already irrevocably published at foreground arrival makes actual capture+consumption exceed that margin, the ordinary strategy may miss a capture-progress goal. This is conditional and untested; no numerical regime is selected.
conditions_not_established: actual period/jitter and available slot slack
page legality and actual preparation benefit
ordinary feedback/partition/large-page performance on equal resources
strong_ordinary_strategy_and_hypothesis.adjacent_counterexample: If legal large-page/static-ring preparation and bounded BG admission make worst-case capture+consumer completion fit the measured reuse margin while completing all finite BG bytes, that same ordinary strategy satisfies the demand. No new mechanism is justified by this card.
strong_ordinary_strategy_and_hypothesis.innovation_or_failure_verdict: root-owned, no positive/negative verdict from source screen

adaptation_cost.existing_available_from_root: Two iDMA + IOMMU + behavioural DDR model; no actual sensor/capture, Ethernet, USB or storage controller.
